items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-18
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: ...Edmond Washington. >> [INTERVIEWER] ...the same band that Edmond Hall was with.

ctx.x: This is crazy, man. This is valuable, man. Tell me. Edmond Washington.

He's the alpha player. Edmond Washington. Yeah. He was down in Florida. I think with Eagle Eye Shields or some of those bands. Anyway, the same band that Edmond Hall was with. He's from New Orleans. Yeah, he plays with Kid Thomas. Mm-hmm . Yeah .
